No autorefractor. The patient can’t read the top line.
So it moves in whole dioptres.
It overshoots into minus on purpose: a young eye can focus through too much minus.
It builds the cylinder up from nothing…
Now it pushes plus, checking the chart as it goes.
One step too far: 20/25. It comes back.
The patient keeps saying minus looks clearer. It has learned not to believe that.
